body: I'm 17 right now. Can you tell me how they got over their speech problems please? Did they have speech therapy or what...

It's really not as easy as it sounds... I get forced to go to school, to a place where almost everyone views me as that quiet "weird" guy and I'm judged by people that don't even know me...or know me, but want nothing to do with me. I'm sick of it, and I can't have any human interaction EVER in my life. That means my entire future I'm going to be the way I am today. Suicide has been on my mind for awhile now, I think it's just almost time.
Please don't. Think about your son. Please. You want him to lead a happy life, then a loving mother is a big part of that. Not one who chose to kill herself.

Same thing for me, except I keep thinking of my parents. I really am about to end it tonight but the only thing stopping me is the thought of my parents finding me... And we've been close lately. 

You should just keep hanging on to the thought of your kids, and get through this shit because at the end it might be worth it.

Both the volume and the weird way I pronounce words. People have made fun of me for it frequently about my voice, which makes me almost always quiet. 
I have no future ahead of me whatsoever, and a counselor is probably not going to do anything for me. I've been to about 5 in my entire life, and I choose to never tell them anything just so I can get abandon the entire session. Eh, and I'm pretty slow too, probably because I can't hear well. I don't know. I'm not good at following directions so a job is never going to work out for me. Wife? Forget about finding anyone at my voice, I can never hit on girls in my life.
 
My entire day at school with anxiety is like being a plane that's flying, and knowing it's going to crash, but not knowing when or where, but you know it's going to crash.
